close.name: close
close.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: an EIGHT-FRAME hand animation sprite sheet on a genuinely transparent background. Generate one 4-column by 2-row sheet, preferably 2048x1024, exactly eight equal cells, NO borders, NO labels and NO background. The reference is a design reference for ONE right white cartoon glove: white fabric, charcoal outline, soft pale blue-gray shading, short white rolled wrist cuff. Palm faces the viewer, thumb on viewer's LEFT, cuff at bottom. Lock hand orientation, palm width, palm center, wrist width, cuff position and lighting across all eight frames. This is the SAME hand closing continuously; never rotate the camera or resize a frame to fill its cell. Palm center is at exactly 50% cell width, 60% cell height; cuff bottom at 92% cell height. Open fingers reach about 8% cell height. Keep the whole hand inside each cell with transparent margins.
Reading order left to right across top row, then bottom row:
0 fully open palm, fingers spread gently.
1 fingertips just start curling inward, only 10% closed.
2 all four finger joints bend slightly, about25% closed.
3 fingers half curled toward the palm, about40% closed.
4 cupped palm, all four fingertips curved toward palm center, about55% closed.
5 fingers mostly folded into palm, about70% closed.
6 almost a closed fist, about85%, thumb moving across fingers.
7 completely closed fist, thumb lying across fingers.
Fingers must progressively shorten by curling/foreshortening, palm and cuff must NOT drift. Five anatomical fingers total in every frame, no extra hands or fingers. No blocks, rope, motion marks, text, accessories or background shadows. Crisp friendly textbook cartoon, clear at100px display. Preserve real alpha transparency.

rope.reference: User-supplied photo of red glove gripping rope
rope.prompt:
Edit the supplied photograph into a clean transparent cartoon sprite. Preserve this EXACT photographed grip, camera angle, silhouette, wrist direction, finger arrangement, joint bends, thumb position and diagonal rope direction. Do not invent a new pose. Keep the wrist entering from the LEFT as in the photograph; do not mirror or rotate anything. The four curled fingers in the front and the thumb lying above the rope must stay in precisely the same anatomical relationship as the photograph.
Change ONLY materials/rendering: replace the red knitted glove and its white dots with a plain WHITE cartoon glove with subtle pale blue-gray shading, smooth charcoal outlines and a simple short white cuff. Keep the tan rope and the way it is squeezed within the grip. No red, no dots, no skin, no long forearm. Remove the sky/background entirely to genuine alpha transparency. Extend the canvas margins enough to show the cuff and fingers without clipping, while keeping the hand shape unchanged. Use a short straight segment of rope on each side of the hand; preserve the photograph's diagonal rope axis through the grip. Do not add fingers, knuckles, rope loops or extra hands. No text, labels, glow or background shadow. Anatomical fidelity to the photo is the primary requirement; this is a stylized redraw of the same hand, not a new cartoon fist.

discarded: Earlier rope-grip drawings were not adopted.
